documentation.content:
The nightly Training Performance Dashboard pipeline logged an error or its Cloud Scheduler trigger failed.

- Logs: Cloud Run functions → daily-pipeline → Logs (look for 'Pipeline run failed')
- Scheduler: Cloud Scheduler → daily-pipeline
- Effect: the dashboard keeps showing the last good data; after 48 hours it shows a staleness warning.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="daily-pipeline" AND severity>=ERROR) OR (resource.type="cloud_scheduler_job" AND resource.labels.job_id="daily-pipeline" AND severity>=ERROR)
